title: Busy Hoon
text:
Busy hoon.
Kaam me nahi —
sochne me ki kaam kab shuru karun. 😅

title: Reply Policy
text:
Reply late aayega.
Pyaar time pe hai,
bas network dheela hai. 📶

title: Mood Off
text:
Mood off hai.
Chai bana do,
sab set ho jaayega. ☕

title: Simple Hoon
text:
Main simple hoon.
Bas logon ko samajhne me
thoda time lagta hai. 🙂

title: Plan Ready
text:
Aaj ka plan:
koi plan nahi.
Aur ye plan perfect chal raha hai. 😎

title: Online Nahi Hoon
text:
Online dikh raha hoon,
par available nahi hoon.
Dono alag cheezein hain. 📱

title: Diet Update
text:
Diet ka pehla din:
salad.
Diet ka doosra din:
salad ke saath samosa.
Progress hai. 🥗

title: Bank Balance
text:
Mera bank balance
aur meri padhai —
dono "thoda aur karna padega" wale stage pe hain. 💸

title: Alarm ka Kaam
text:
Alarm ka kaam mujhe uthana nahi,
mujhe yaad dilana hai
ki main so raha hoon. ⏰

title: Multitasking
text:
Main multitasking kar sakta hoon:
ek saath kuch nahi kar sakta
aur thak bhi sakta hoon. 😴

title: Weekend Plan
text:
Weekend ka plan bana liya.
Ab bas weekend ka intezaar,
aur plan ka cancel hona baaki hai. 📅

title: Expert Advice
text:
Main har cheez ka expert hoon —
jab tak koi sawal na pooche. 🎓

title: Good Morning — Chai Wala
text:
Good Morning! ☀️
Aaj ka din aapke liye
utna hi accha ho
jitni subah ki pehli chai. ☕

title: Good Morning — Alarm
text:
Subah ho gayi! 🌅
Alarm ne apna kaam kar diya,
ab aapki baari hai.
Good Morning!

title: Good Morning — Muskaan
text:
Aaj subah aaine me dekha —
koi bahut accha insaan muskura raha tha.
Good Morning, aap! 😊

title: Good Morning — Naya Din
text:
Kal jo nahi ho paya,
wo aaj ho sakta hai.
Naya din, nayi shuruaat.
Good Morning! 🌞

title: Good Morning — 5 Minute
text:
Uth jaiye!
Wo "paanch minute"
aadhe ghante ka plan bana chuka hai. 😴
Good Morning!

title: Good Morning — Simple
text:
Good Morning! 🌻
Aaj kuch bada na sahi,
kuch accha zaroor ho.

title: Good Night — Phone Rakhiye
text:
Good Night! 🌙
Ab phone rakh dijiye,
warna subah phir "5 minute" hoga.

title: Good Night — Tension
text:
Aaj ki tension
aaj ke saath so jaaye.
Kal ka kal dekhenge.
Good Night! 😌

title: Good Night — Sapne
text:
Aapke sapne itne acche hon
ki alarm bura lage.
Good Night! ✨

title: Good Night — Charging
text:
Phone charge pe laga diya,
ab khud bhi charge ho jaiye.
Good Night! 🔋

title: Good Night — Short
text:
Good Night! 🌛
Din accha tha ya nahi,
neend achhi honi chahiye.

title: Dost Wala Status
text:
Mere dost paisa nahi dete,
par waqt dete hain —
aur waqt mehnga hai. 🤝

title: Best Friend
text:
Best friend wo hai
jisse ladne ke baad bhi
khana usi ke saath khana hai. 🍽️

title: Purani Dosti
text:
Kuch dosti purani sharab jaisi nahi,
chai jaisi hoti hai —
roz chahiye. ☕

title: Group ka Sach
text:
Hamare group me koi leader nahi hai.
Sab confuse hain,
par saath hain. 😄

title: Dost ki Keemat
text:
Ek accha dost
100 followers se zyada kaam ka hai. 🎗️

title: Shayari — Chai
text:
Ishq bhi kya cheez hai,
kabhi jalata hai kabhi rulata hai,
lekin chai roz sambhal leti hai
jo dil tootne se bach jata hai. ☕

title: Shayari — Battery
text:
Dil ki battery low hai,
charger tumhare paas hai,
par tum bhi aajkal
power cut me rehti ho. 🔌

title: Shayari — Salary
text:
Mahine ki pehli tareekh,
chehre pe noor aa jata hai,
aur pachchees tareekh ko
wahi chehra philosopher ban jata hai. 💸

title: Shayari — Neend
text:
Neend meri mehmaan hai,
aati hai bin bulaye,
bas exam ki raat ko
sabse pehle aa jaye. 😴

title: Shayari — Diet
text:
Kasam khayi thi diet ki,
iraade bhi nek the,
samose ne dekha aur bola —
kitne kamzor irade the. 🥟

title: Shayari — Reply
text:
Tere reply ka intezaar
itna lamba ho gaya,
ki message ab purana
aur dil ab sayana ho gaya. 💬
